text: 55-year-old male bodybuilder. The patient has been experiencing weakness in his right arm for a few weeks, which has progressively worsened to the point of dropping objects. He also reports a recent unexplained weight loss of 17 pounds and has a history of diabetes. The patient admits to chronic alcohol use, heavy smoking, and anabolic steroid use.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of diabetes, alcohol use, and anabolic steroid use, could you tell me if you experience any muscle cramps, tremors, or specific areas of numbness in your right arm? Also, have you noticed any changes in your blood sugar levels recently?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Weakness in the right arm. I also have Decreased sensation in the right arm, Dull aching and burning pain in the right arm, Significant weight loss.

speaker: Doctor
text: That burning pain combined with weakness and weight loss is concerning; have you noticed any visible muscle wasting or shrinking in the right arm compared to the left? Additionally, do you have any history of thyroid issues or other endocrine disorders?
